profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ LinkedIn | Building Compliance Monitoring Platform and Data Deletion Solutions

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Building Compliance Monitoring Platform (CMON) which is an automated data-driven detection system. It enables us to continuously stay compliant with rules set through Legal, Security, Trust, and Data at LinkedIn.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Building Data Compliance and management systems.

-> Help build LinkedIn’s data ecosystem consists of online and offline distributed platforms. Uses Kafka, Espresso, Hadoop, and MySQL to process data at a large scale. To ensure we are handling data responsibly, I work on utilizing the Compliance Monitoring (CMON) Platform to scan all of our systems for issues. 

-> The CMON platform leverages an end-to-end pipeline across our systems which detects violations and surfaces insights, metrics, and tickets. It also provides a unified view across metadata attached to people, schemas, data sets, owners, purge policies, access patterns/controls, and member PII and settings so that all system behaviors operate as expected.

-> CMON approach is a unique effort to operationalize unprecedented visibility into how the LinkedIn ecosystem operates. Integration with the CMON platform is a mandatory component of all engineering efforts on the horizon which serves to improve the craftsmanship of our products. Since launch, we are proud to have surfaced and resolved issues that required attention, and as we improve our detection models we will be able to dry-run scenarios and forecast violations enabling teams to be well-informed and prevent issues.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Experience in leading team from project proposals to project deployments
Knowledge on machine learning algorithms and deep learning with large scale analytics and cyber security
➢Implement ML algorithm and TensorFlow for feature points detection and real-time video stitching by SIFT image registration algorithm and Gaussian Elimination algorithm
➢ Implement obstacle detection with deep learning using SSD (Single Shot Multibox Detector)
➢ Computer vision - detect real-time feature points, stitching real-time videos, and detect obstacles based on received data (GPS, Lidar, Accelerometer, Ultrasound, Proximity, and Optical Encoder)
➢Interacting frequently with sales department for feedback and further improvement
➢Developing an automated guided vehicle system using LPC1769, NVIDIA Jetson, RF module, and LPCXpresso software tool

positions.title: Graduate Associate Teacher
positions.description: I was responsible for teaching microprocessor architecture and assembly language, design of peripheral blocks and their interfaces to the microprocessor, and designing projects using standard integrated circuit packages.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Research on the development of LPC/Nvidia GPU interface systems for dumping detection system
Research on the data analysis and data transmission through UART, PWM, GPIO, ExINT, RTC, SPI and ADC interfaces to provide the most creative, impactful technologies to disrupt industries and transform lifestyles, so too can San José become a global leader for civic innovation.

company.name: San José State University Research Foundation

honors.title: Tau Beta Pi
honors.description:
Scholastic Requirements
Undergraduate students:
Must be in the top 1/8th of your junior class or top 1/5th of your senior class.
Graduate students:
Must be in the top 1/5th of your class or, if class rank can not be determined, obtain a letter of recommendation from your primary academic advisor.

honors.title: SJSU Annual Dean’s Scholars
honors.description: Undergraduate students who have earned a 3.65 or higher grade point average at San José State University in at least two contiguous semesters of the three semesters prior to the Honors Convocation.

volunteerExperiences.description: As a teaching volunteer at North Star Eduction Center, I work with preschool teachers and after school teacher assistants to teach children through a structured curriculum in Math, Physics, and Computer Science.

projects.title: E-commerce Recommendation Algorithm and Web Development
projects.description:
Web UI design in HTML 5, CSS, Adobe XD, Node.js and MySQL for database integration
➢ Used Postgresql and Apache Hbase to build the database/storage
➢ Implemented Item-Item based collaborative filtering to build a web application that recommends movies in Ruby on Rails ➢ Populated the database with a large dataset from Data.gov (> 500,000 samples, > 100 features, and > 50M non-zeros)

projects.title: E-commerce Car Sales Web Application
projects.description:
➢ Utilized node.js as the back-end API language and used Embedded JavaScript as the html engine to efficiently process the dynamic UI functionalities with the help of CSS
➢ Used Mysql as database engine on AWS for remote, multi-user access
➢ Incorporated the MVC model which improved the readability and expandability of the application
➢ Web functionality, usability, performance and compatibility testing in Selenium framework and tested APIs with Postman
